name: Llanowar
description: A forest where Mirri lives and the crew fights an aboroth.

description_citations.text: "Rath and Storm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Freyalise's help the Llanowar elves keep their culture intact through the Ice Age and Thaw, and the Steel Leaf takes isolationism to the extreme.
timeline.quote: With the help of Freyalise the elves of Llanowar managed to keep their cultures intact throughout even the most difficult of times.

citation.text: "Llanowar", section "Ice Age and the Thaw". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Rofellos is killed, Gerrard leaves the ship and Mirri goes with him, then travels to Llanowar to tell Rofellos's family.
timeline.quote: Rofellos was killed in the attack on Crovax's Estate

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Three years later Gerrard asks Mirri to be his Lieutenant and she rejoins the crew to rescue Captain Sisay.
timeline.quote: Gerrard and Mirri both were instrumental in stopping the rampaging monster

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An aboroth chases the Weatherlight until elvish war machines stop it.
timeline.quote: The monster pursues the Weatherlight, almost catching its sails when it is stopped by elvish war machines.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Tahngarth's Tale" ( Hannovi Braddock )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard defeats the aboroth with the Thran Forge and the Touchstone.
timeline.quote: Gerrard turned the aboroth into metal pieces with the Thran forge and then deactivated it with the Touchstone

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Tahngarth's Tale" ( Hannovi Braddock )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth admits that the Weatherlight needs Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth begrudgingly admits to Orim that the Weatherlight needs Gerrard

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Tahngarth's Tale" ( Hannovi Braddock )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elves of Llanowar welcome Benalish soldiers into the forest.
timeline.quote: For the first time, elves welcomed Benalish soldiers into the forest with something other than arrows.

citation.text: Llanowar Cavalry (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.quote: Llanowar rallied around Eladamri's banner and united in his name.

citation.text: Llanowar Vanguard (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian airships bombard Llanowar with plague bombs, killing Takara and King Fhedusil; Eladamri guides survivors to the Dreaming Caves.
timeline.quote: causing enormous casualties, including Takara and the king himself

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Seed of Freyalise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elves of Llanowar pledge loyalty to Eladamri, declaring him the seed of Freyalise.
timeline.quote: declaring him the seed of Freyalise

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Seed of Freyalise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Plague bombs drop on Llanowar; Takara dies saving elves and Eladamri soothes refugees in the Dreaming Caves.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mirri lives for a while in Llanowar, where she meets Rofellos.
timeline.quote: This is where she met Rofellos .

citation.text: "Llanowar", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion all Llanowar rallies around Eladamri and successfully defends the forest from the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: During the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria , all Llanowar rallied around Eladamri 's banner and united in his name, successfully defending the forest from the Phyrexians .

citation.text: "Llanowar", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Mending Llanowar is among the first regions to be rejuvenated.
timeline.quote: Llanowar was one of the first Dominarian regions that were rejuvenated after the Mending .

citation.text: "Llanowar", section "Post-Mending". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse, Benalia attacks Llanowar during the second Brothers' War, forcing the elves to mechanize and cut down the forest.
timeline.quote: Benalia attacked Llanowar while expanding their borders.

citation.text: "Llanowar", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret studies Tannuk, remarking on Llanowar and the power he is afraid of.
timeline.quote: So far from Llanowar … such power in the form.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.
